LanguageData.RHA_StarCadence030_Brief: Leave the first firing lane, then move out of the crosswise sweep through your original position. Each beat has a separate locked warning. Focus fire or existing control can interrupt the sequence. Interruption, a clean dodge or full shield absorption leaves a 4-second opening with 25% extra damage; if a beat causes wounds, the opening lasts 1.5 seconds. You can keep attacking throughout. Defeat the core with personal damage or actual shield and healing contribution.
